action_description: Added a Qwen TP2-gated GEMM2 warp-sliced I dequant fast path for I=1024 and gemm2_scale_cols=32. Each warp computes one compact grouped local slot and one hidden output column, with lanes owning disjoint 32-element I scale blocks, using the existing block32 FP4/mid vectorized helpers, reducing lane partials in-warp, and calling the parent finalize helper. The parent two-column grouped GEMM2 kernel remains the fallback for all other scale shapes.
